scope: Vertical-column axial selfweight with vendor rigid ends, real sections and physical-member line/point-load meshing.
scopeZh: 真实截面竖柱刚域与轴向自重，以及保留物理构件身份的梁局部线载、点载分段。

route.geometry: Official yjkSPre_GenData in an owned private host; read generated FRAME.RZL before calculation.
route.input: Recompile a new SDK YDB with a midpoint axial point and rigid-segment nodal loads; source UDL/model remains immutable.
route.execution: Second owned host under the same job and lease imports the new YDB, generates native data and calls yjkdesign_dsncalculating_cal_design once.
route.physicalBasis: Exact linear axial virtual work: q*elasticLength/2 at each elastic end and q*rigidLength at each physical node. The internal point-load field is not a physical uniform-load field.
route.actualInput: Final FE COLUMN CONLOAD DIR=LX and NODELOAD readback, separately audited from the expected-load view.
route.exportViewNotExecuted: axial-gravity-expected-loads.dat is a diagnostic expectation, never passed to the native solver.

consumerContract.hashes: sourceFeaSha256 binds final executed native FE; geometryFeaSha256 binds first official generation. After physical mesh restoration physicalModelHash binds source, compiledModelHash and sourceModelHash bind compiled input.
consumerContract.positions: nativeRigidLengthsM follows nativeNodeIds; sourceNodeIds and physical segment interval are explicit.
consumerContract.directResults: Only native elastic-end cuts and original physical nodes are published; never label an internal computational point field as the source UDL response.
consumerContract.recovery: Source physicalCompilation remains unchanged. Consistent executed rows are tagged executionMethod=consistent-axial-load-vector; consumers must inspect actual point and node contributions.
consumerContract.nodeAggregation: nativeNodeAggregates records total source/native nodal loads. An individual rigid-segment contribution must not be inferred from an aggregate with other contributors.

retainedFailures.reason: Original rigid-column UDL axial displacement mismatch; source load interpolation required consistent compilation.
